promotion_gate.required: candidate must improve pooled margin MAE and total MAE versus the exact 6.5D feature set and may not be worse on both margin and total MAE in either held-out season
promotion_gate.per_signal_authority: zero unless carried by a passing out-of-sample feature set; no narrative trend receives authority by itself

locked_rules: Only information known before kickoff may enter a feature row.
Sportsbook spread, total, odds, implied probability, closing line, consensus price and ADP are prohibited from fitting, selection and targets.
The incumbent 6.5D football feature set is the comparison baseline and may not be weakened to make situational features look better.
Missing situational data is unknown, not zero, unless zero has a defined football meaning for that feature.
A historical trend may be displayed as context without receiving numeric forecast authority.
No situational effect may be double counted in team priors, player matchup layers and game adjustments without an explicit decomposition.
Outputs remain SHADOW_ONLY until the full backward audit and later promotion governance.
